objectives.name: market-data-validation
objectives.threshold_basis: One normalized acquisition/validation outcome per production run; 99% permits 0.30 failed outcomes per 30 runs.

objectives.name: forecast-model-execution
objectives.threshold_basis: One normalized inference outcome per production run; target is measured only after 30 observations.

objectives.name: forecast-history-persistence
objectives.threshold_basis: One normalized durable-history write outcome per publishable forecast; no more than 0.03 failures per 30 events.

objectives.name: service-api-dependencies
objectives.description: Abstract external API dependency outcomes, ready for #218/#219 integrations.
objectives.threshold_basis: One normalized external dependency outcome per attempted call; provider instrumentation is supplied by #218/#219.

objectives.name: forecast-publication
objectives.description: Public forecast artifact and site publication outcomes.
objectives.threshold_basis: One normalized publication outcome per approved forecast run; freshness timing remains governed by freshness_slo.json.
